_appid: Skip Steam: the Dreamcast Soul Calibur (1999) has no Steam release. The only Steam entry is the 2018 Soulcalibur VI, a different game whose art would misrepresent this package.
description: Soulcalibur (Dreamcast 1999 Namco, USA, via RetroArch / Flycast)
name: Soul Calibur
short: Namco's weapon fighter and the Dreamcast's showcase launch title: sixteen warriors duel for the cursed Soul Edge, with a mission-battle single-player and 8-way-run movement.
